July - BBQ Sauce and Rub Month!!!

I've been using Arthur Bryant's rub on my slow and low meats lately.

Its been lights out. Especially on brisket. A bit expensive to buy and ship, but I found a copy cat recipe and and its been working great.

https://axokuaci.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/arthur-bryants-meat-rib-rub-copycat/

Ingredients:

½ cup salt

2/3 cup paprika

2/3 cup sugar

2/3 cup packed brown sugar

1 tablespoon ground mustard

1 teaspoon white pepper

1 teaspoon black pepper

¾ teaspoon ground celery seed

2 teaspoons powdered onion

2 teaspoons powdered garlic

Preparation:

Combine all of the spices into a food processor, mix them up, and store in an airtight container.
